statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd'); br=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); eff=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // empty'); [ -n "$eff" ] || eff=$(jq -r '.effortLevel // empty' "$HOME/.claude/settings.json" 2>/dev/null);ctx=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); five=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); week=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty'); E=$(printf '\033'); R="${E}[0m"; sep="${E}[90m | ${R}"; lvl() { v=$(printf '%.0f' "$1"); if [ "$v" -ge 80 ]; then c="${E}[31m"; elif [ "$v" -ge 50 ]; then c="${E}[33m"; else c="${E}[32m"; fi; printf '%s%s %s%%%s' "$c" "$2" "$v" "$R"; }; out=''; add() { if [ -n "$out" ]; then out="${out}${sep}$1"; else out="$1"; fi; }; [ -n "$br" ] && add "${br}"; m="${E}[36m${model}${R}"; [ -n "$eff" ] && m="${m} ${E}[2;36m(${eff})${R}"; add "$m"; [ -n "$ctx" ] && add "$(lvl "$ctx" ctx)"; [ -n "$five" ] && add "$(lvl "$five" 5h)"; [ -n "$week" ] && add "$(lvl "$week" 7d)"; printf '%s' "$out"
